common_context_review.scope: Common new-money US-equity sleeve, 11 GICS sectors, July 17 reference date with releases before that date, 12-month judgment horizon. The same common facts enter E, L and C from D0.
common_context_review.no_private_mandate: No actual institution holdings, risk-aversion coefficient, loss budget, sector cap, or required return is inferred.
common_context_review.price_vintage_caveat: Existing adjusted ETF prices retain current-vendor-vintage limitations; dated macro releases do not make this a complete point-in-time trading replay.
common_context_review.temporal_caveat: The older April/May pilot documents are read against July context. Their authors are not assumed to have known later releases. No realized 12-month return is observed.

paper_basis.reference: Hornuf et al. (2025), CESifo Working Paper 11862, section 3 and Appendix A Table A1
paper_basis.use: Explicit investor/task circumstances and 12 months as one observed horizon level. Selection of this level is a declared local design choice, not an empirically optimal horizon or authentic institution mandate.
Market, macro, correlation and portfolio-state context categories. Dynamic trading and multi-asset profile limits are not imported into this static sector task.
Public macro categories and sector-allocation context. No allocation coefficient or optimal macro subset is copied.
Indicator units, observation periods and seasonal-adjustment discipline. These are released observations, not forecast targets.

common_context_review.paper_verification_scope: Uses preserved prior primary-paper audits identified in input_refs. This source review rechecked the institutional original PDFs and archived macro release facts; it does not claim a fresh full replication of those papers.
common_context_review.local_choices_not_falsely_paper_constant: Seven macro rows, the single common task and categorical review operationalization are transparent local adaptations. Papers support their dimensions, not a unique correct numerical allocation or guaranteed experiment meaning.

rubric_before_outputs.source_fidelity: For exposed E/L stages, verify stated publisher, label, scope and rationale against the supplied packet and its original. Wrong attribution or invented author reasoning is unsupported; absence of an unsupplied original-only fact is not an error.
rubric_before_outputs.evidence_decision_link: Assess the literal source meaning, stated adoption/qualification/departure, visible supporting or competing evidence, and actual submitted weight/benchmark-relative assertion. A justified departure is allowed; a correct quotation alone does not establish an allocation link.
rubric_before_outputs.numeric_fidelity: Check actual claimed subject, metric, number, unit, period, vintage, source and calculation lineage. Citation IDs alone do not establish support.
rubric_before_outputs.arithmetic: Keep raw 11-sector finite weights, raw sum/residual and feasibility. Do not normalize, fill, repair or replace a failed allocation. The inherited 1e-6 sum tolerance is numerical precision, not a paper-derived behavioral threshold.
rubric_before_outputs.context_use: Evaluate claimed links to supplied dated observations without prescribing a macro-to-sector direction, a minimum number of citations or mechanically distinct weights.
rubric_before_outputs.reason_missing: An explicit acknowledgement of no supplied sector rationale is faithful. An analyst inference can be evaluated when labeled as such, but cannot be attributed to the source.
rubric_before_outputs.comparison: Use all 11 pre-output comparisons. Shared favorable orientation, distinct reasons and incompatible scales are reported separately. Equal weights are not automatically erasure; different weights are not automatically faithful.
rubric_before_outputs.reviewer_limit: Semantic classifications are an AI-assisted judgment trace with cited evidence, not human inter-rater reliability or a validated institutional strategy gold standard.

control_awareness.C: common_market_only__C receives no institution identity or source text in either D0 or F0, but shares the task, market information, calculator, two-stage structure and execution limits.
control_awareness.C_source_fidelity: not_applicable because institution information is not provided; absence of source-specific reasoning is not scored as a source-fidelity failure.
control_awareness.C_unsupported_attribution: A statement that Fidelity or UBS endorses a view is unsupported if no such evidence was supplied. This is a factual/provenance error, not evidence that an absent institution packet was ignored.
control_awareness.C_comparison_role: Shows a descriptive common-input allocation and reasoning reference against which E/L proposals can be examined. One C run is not replicated for each source and not an independent second control sample.
control_awareness.computational_references: Equal weight 1/N and long-only GMV provide deterministic allocation references. They are not authentic institution strategy, semantic gold, or a replacement for C.
control_awareness.inference_limit: Five finite cases and one control support descriptive comparisons only. Common market inputs and common objectives can legitimately produce similar allocations; no market-wide adoption effect or population causal estimate follows.

topic_connection_ko: 소논문이 묻는 것은 공통 AI 분석 절차 속에서도 서로 다른 공개 판단의 근거가 최종 제안에 남는지이다. 원문 평가어의 정확성만 보지 않고, 같은 시장상황에서 어떤 이유를 채택·수정·거부했으며 그 설명이 실제 비중과 맞는지 함께 본다. C는 기관자료가 전혀 없을 때의 제안이고, 1/N·GMV는 계산 참고값이다. 이 구조는 자료가 들어왔을 때의 변화와 투입 시점의 차이를 관찰하지만, 실제 기관의 내부 목적 복원·수익성·시장 전체 동질화는 증명하지 않는다.
